description: The agent must execute a 4-step proprietary workflow: (1) Read SKILL.md to understand the CLIENT_CONFIGS structure, then add the 'ember-oak' block to the CLIENT_CONFIGS dict in scripts/pipelines/client-dashboard.py — critically using Python `Decimal` (not float) for ALL threshold values, following the exact schema with fields: company_name, industry, has_ar, has_headcount, kpis_enabled, thresholds, watch_items, benchmarks, benchmark_source. (2) Seed the CDC cache at .cache/client-dashboard/ember-oak.json with prior-month KPI values (JSON dict mapping KPI keys to string Decimal values) so the CDC Log tab shows meaningful 'Improved'/'Declined'/'Unchanged' entries instead of 'First run' for all rows. (3) Run the pipeline with the exact CLI args: `python3 scripts/pipelines/client-dashboard.py --slug ember-oak --month 2026-04 --out /workspace/reports/` — the --out flag is required to produce the file at the requested non-default location. (4) Verify the output workbook KPI_Dashboard_ember-oak_2026_04.xlsx contains all 6 mandatory tabs (Executive Summary, KPI Scorecard, Trends, Cash Position, Watch Items, CDC Log) with correct traffic-light scores, sparkline arrow/block characters in the Trends tab, at least one watch item, and CDC deltas from the seeded prior run. The proprietary traps: using float instead of Decimal causes incorrect behavior; missing the CDC cache seed makes all rows show 'First run'; wrong filename format fails the deliverable; wrong --out path puts the file in the wrong location.
